tweets.text:
In Agent Memory Repo, memory records live in files and are versioned with Git

It’s a simple primitive but unlocks surprising use cases like a message board across your agent sessions

Introducing Dreaming: Across sessions, Devin builds a memory graph of how you like to work

At night Devin self-improves its memory to remove stale records and discover latent information

We are creating an OSS standard called Agent Memory Repo: https://t.co/b6qzEJsaeT https://t.co/G3o1WQqQbN

tweets.text:
The serious answer to how Shazam worked is it took the peaks of a spectrogram of short clips of every song, find the peaks from the highest amplitude bits, hash it with the value being (time stamp, track id) and then the actual recognition is a hashtable lookup.

We did this for a college CS project. The original paper is fantastic:

If you’re a VC dunking on this, you better have a grand total of one investment.

Otherwise, you are, definitionally, buying yourself options. https://t.co/ojPjl7geEq
